mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workitem_comment_delivery (tenant_id, source_type, workitem_id, comment_id, target_agent_id, dispatch_id, executor_id, status, error) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{sourceType}, #{workitemId}, #{commentId}, #{targetAgentId}, #{dispatchId}, #{executorId}, #{status}, #{error})

INSERT INTO workitem_comment_delivery (tenant_id, workitem_id, comment_id, target_agent_id, dispatch_id, executor_id, status, error) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{commentId}, #{targetAgentId}, #{dispatchId}, #{executorId}, #{status}, #{error})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workitem_comment_delivery WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT FROM workitem_comment_delivery g JOIN dispatch d ON d.id = g.dispatch_id AND d.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.executor_id = #{executorId} AND g.status = 'DELIVERED' AND d.status IN ('PENDING', 'PACKAGING', 'DISPATCHED', 'ACKED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSING', 'PAUSE_FAILED') ORDER BY g.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET dispatch_id = #{dispatchId}, executor_id = #{executorId}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET dispatch_id = #{dispatchId}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET status = #{status}, error = #{error}, delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELIVERED' THEN NOW() ELSE delivered_at END, applied_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPLIED' THEN NOW() ELSE applied_at END, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET status = #{status}, error = #{error}, applied_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPLIED' THEN NOW() ELSE applied_at END, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND executor_id = #{executorId} AND status = 'DELIVERED'

UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET status = 'QUEUED', dispatch_id = NULL, executor_id = NULL, delivered_at = NULL, error = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND status = 'DELIVERED'

UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET status = 'QUEUED', dispatch_id = #{dispatchId}, executor_id = NULL, delivered_at = NULL, applied_at = NULL, error = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND status IN ('DELIVERED', 'FAILED')
UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET status = 'FAILED', error = #{error}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'DELIVERED')
UPDATE workitem_comment_delivery SET reply_comment_id = #{replyCommentId}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND reply_comment_id IS NULL
